title: Print flat, as it flies
summary: The frame prints flat on its underside, as it flies (print_tilt_deg 0), with tree supports. The orientation scan (fea.print_orientation, on CalculiX's PETG crash stresses) found no pose loses strength to the layers: the frame's worst crash tension runs along them in every candidate near flat or on edge. Flat needs support under 22 % of its surface (support_area_max_frac allows 35 %) and stands 20 mm tall.

rejected.why: about half the support (10 %), but a 111 mm tall part balanced on a 20-38 mm rim: five times the layers, a wobbling print for a kid to babysit, and no strength gained
support 12-15 % but up to 14 % of the strength lost across the layers, and an awkward pose
